company.name: Squire
company.shortDescription: The AI platform to automate medical documentation
company.description:
At Squire, we’re giving doctors back their time. Our AI-powered solution automates consultation reports, cutting admin time so general practitioners can focus on patient care. But we're not stopping there—our mission is to streamline administrative tasks across the board, supporting healthcare providers to reduce their admin time.

Founded in Ghent, we’re on a mission to reduce patient stops, starting in Belgium and scaling across Europe.

Join us in making healthcare smarter, faster, and more human.
